reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch hold that Moses saw only a manifestation of God suited to human limits, not the unveiled divine glory no one may see and live.

sides.snippet: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend.
sides.verseText: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn't depart out of the Tent.

sides.snippet: You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.
sides.verseText: He said, \"You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.\"
